---
title: "CV"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
# A download button, then the CV itself open on the page, as on
# kentikelenis.net/cv.html (Thomas, 11 November 2026; no introduction). The
# PDF is copied from Thomas's Dropbox by R/refresh-publications.R whenever his
# copy there is newer (decision 21), so it sits at a fixed address. Its size
# is read from the file when the page is rendered. The frame is hidden on
# phones, whose browsers mostly cannot show a PDF inside a page; the button
# opens it there.
cv_file <- "files/cv/Thomas_Stubbs_CV.pdf"
cv_kb <- round(file.size(cv_file) / 1024)
```

::: cta
<a class="cta-btn solid" href="../files/cv/Thomas_Stubbs_CV.pdf"><i class="bi bi-download" aria-hidden="true"></i> Download the CV (PDF, `r cv_kb` KB)</a>
:::

<iframe class="cv-frame" src="../files/cv/Thomas_Stubbs_CV.pdf#view=FitH" title="Curriculum vitae of Thomas Stubbs"></iframe>
